consent.title: Help improve PRUNplanner?
consent.intro: With your permission, PRUNplanner collects how the tool is used. This helps to decide which features to build next and to find and fix bugs.
consent.collected_events: Usage events, such as pages you open and actions you take
consent.collected_recordings: Session recordings of some visits, with everything you type masked
consent.linked: This data is linked to your account id and stored with PostHog in the EU.
consent.optional: This is optional and you can change your choice any time in your Profile. Details are in the {link}.
